plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for SonicWall firewall. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, fan, sessions/connections, max sessions, interface traffic, and NAT translations (enterprise PEN 8741).
name: Firewall

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the SonicWall firewall since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Overall CPU utilization of the SonicWall firewall (SONICWALL-FIREWALL-IP-STATISTICS-MIB sonicCurrentCPUUtil) as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate inspection overload or attack traffic.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage_management
metrics.description: Management-plane CPU utilization of the SonicWall firewall (SONICWALL-FIREWALL-IP-STATISTICS-MIB sonicCurrentManagementCPUUtil) as a 0-100 percentage.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage_fwd_inspect
metrics.description: Forwarding and inspection CPU utilization of the SonicWall firewall (SONICWALL-FIREWALL-IP-STATISTICS-MIB sonicCurrentFwdAndInspectCPUUtil) as a 0-100 percentage.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: RAM utilization of the SonicWall firewall (SONICWALL-FIREWALL-IP-STATISTICS-MIB sonicCurrentRAMUtil) reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. High memory pressure can degrade connection handling.

metrics.name: firewall_active_sessions
metrics.description: Number of current connection-cache entries on the SonicWall firewall (SONICWALL-FIREWALL-IP-STATISTICS-MIB sonicCurrentConnCacheEntries). A rapid rise can indicate a connection flood or connection-cache exhaustion risk.

metrics.name: firewall_max_connections
metrics.description: Maximum number of connection-cache entries supported by the SonicWall firewall (SONICWALL-FIREWALL-IP-STATISTICS-MIB sonicMaxConnCacheEntries). Combined with active sessions it gauges remaining connection-table headroom.

metrics.name: firewall_nat_translations
metrics.description: Current number of NAT translation entries on the SonicWall firewall (SONICWALL-FIREWALL-IP-STATISTICS-MIB sonicNatTranslationCount).

metrics.name: device_sensor_value
metrics.description: Raw hardware sensor reading from sonicwallSensorsTable (Device/Value/Unit). Temperature, fan, and power rows are identified by Name/Unit rather than invented status enumerations.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Hardware temperature rows from sonicwallSensorsTable, selected by Unit (C/Celsius) or Device name containing temp.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: Fan sensor rows from sonicwallSensorsTable, selected by Unit (RPM) or Device name containing fan. Values are the vendor-reported reading, not a normalized health enum.
